tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dge slong kun dga' shes rab la gdams pa'i sdom gsum dris lan bzhugs so//

/oṃ swa sti/ srid pa gsum na 'gran pa'i zla bral ba// bdud dang mu stegs zil gyis gnon mdzad cing*// byang chub rnam pa gsum gyi lam ston pa// go'u tam ston pa de la gus pas 'dud// rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen rtse'i ri bong ni// yongs rdzogs gsal bar 'dzin pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// phrin las 'od dkar phyogs bcur 'gyed mdzad pa// mgon po klu sgrub zhes grags de la 'dud// gang sku rnam dag mtshan dpe'i dpal gyis brgyan// gang gsung tshangs dbyangs nam mkha'i lto ba 'gengs// lham me lhan ne g.yo med thugs mnga' ba// nā gardzu na'i rnam 'phrul de la 'dud// mgon po khyod kyi thugs rje phrin las shugs// sred med bus kyang zlog par mi nus la// nam yang dus las yol ba mi mnga' zhes// yang dang yang du seng ge'i sgra sgrog ltar// da dus snyigs ma'i sems can bsod nams dman// mi dge'i bshes gnyen dbang song spang blang 'dzol// gdul dka'i sems can rnams kyi don slad du// bsam bzhin srid pa nye bar bzung bar mngon// kun nas yangs pa'i rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus// 'gro rnams dga' bskyed gser ris yongs bskor zhing*// rin chen nyi zla'i phreng bas rab brgyan pa'i// gang sku lhun po'i dpal la gus phyag 'tshal// kun gsal nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor yangs pa la// dga' byed chu 'dzin mthug po rab tu 'khrigs// tshangs pa'i dbyangs ltar 'brug gi sgra chen sgrog /rin chen chos kyi char rgyun stsol la 'dud// kun khyab chos kyi dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor las// zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i 'od stong can// dga' bcas rta bdun rlung gi bgrod pa yis// rin chen byang chub sems kyi 'bras ster ba'i// gdul bya'i blo yi pad tshal rgyas mdzad 'dud// mkhyen bzang rab tu rgyas pa'i nags tshal du// rin chen tshul khrims ral pa'i zur phud can// shes rab me la nyon mongs bud shing sreg

/sde snod dbyug gu gsum 'dzin khyod la 'dud// phun tshogs rin chen ljon pa rab mdzes shing*// phrin las 'dab phyogs tsu ta rab rgyas pa// rmad byung snying po'i khur gyi brjid pa can// rgyal ba dpag bsam ljon pa la phyag 'tshal// mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje'i phrin las kyis// gang gi srid pa'i dgra sde ma lus pa// rab bcom zhi ba'i go 'phang mngon mdzad pa'i// nyon mongs bdud las rnam rgyal la phyag 'tshal// khyed gsung dri med bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun ni// rab bsil tsha gdung kun nas zhi byed nyid// gang gis bsten na 'di phyi'i 'bras ster ba// rgyun du gdams par mdzad kyang da dung ni// rmongs pa'i tha tshig zhu ba 'di skad ces// nyan thos byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa yi// spyi yi chings dang gnad kyi lde mig gcig /rab tu gdams shing gnang bar mdzad du gsol// snying nas dad pas gsol ba 'di btab pas// snying gi ze'u 'brur sim par gyur pa yi// snying por gyur pa'i sdom gsum la brten te// snying dang 'dra ba'i 'gro drug ma rgan rnams// snying bral 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol te// snying po byang chub chen po thob par shog /ces pa 'di rje nyid la mi phyed pa'i dad pa dang ldan zhing*/ shākya'i btsun pa'i tha chung du gyur pa/ ā nan+da pra dz+nyās gsol ba 'di ltar btab pa'i don bde blag tu 'grub pa'i bka' drin bstsal du gsol/ 'khor 'das dus gsum bsags dang yod dge ni// gdod nas lhan skyes sems kyi dkyil 'khor du// bden gnyis zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi sku// 'jig rten mgon po'i go 'phang thob par shog/ ༈ //bu'i dam pa slob ma'i yang rab rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dge slong ā n+dan pra dz+nyā'i spangs pa dang rtogs pa'i sgo nas/ sdom gsum gyi dri ba las/ sdom pa gsum gyi phyogs snga ma blang zhing*/ rang bzhed sgrub cing lung gi sbyin pa/

phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims rin po che gcig tshul sogs dgos zhes pa'i lan du/ 'di ltar mdor bsdus brjod par bya ste/ phyogs snga ma sdom gsum rnam gzhag sdom gsum rab dbye/ yar ldan/ 'chol srung sogs gleng ba yod de/ rnam gzhag ni so thar dang byang sems gsang sngags gsum gyi rnam par bzhag pas te/ tha dad du nges zhes brjod cing*/ rab dbye yang de dang mtshungs pas te/ sdom pa gsum gzhi bsam pa mi gcig lam sbyor ba mi gcig thob bya 'bras bu mi gcig ces so// yar ldan ni snga ma snga ma spangs te/ phyi ma phyi ma sgrub ste chu brgal ba'i zam pa dang mtshungs zhes brjod/ 'chol bsrung ni so thar gyi dus su dge ba bcu bsrungs nas/ dgag sgrub kyi bslab bya nyams su len/ nyan thos dang mthun par byed/ byang sems kyi skabs gzhan don la 'gro na/ mi dge ba bdun kyang gnang bar 'dod cing*/ bkag pa gnang bar 'dod ste byang sems dang mthun par byed gsang sngags kyi bkag pa thams cad gnang zhes 'dod yon la bag med du spyod ste/ gsang sngags dang mthun par byed/ spyod lam gang mkho mkho sgrub pa ste spang bya'o// da ni rang bzhed sdom gsum gnad gcig ni ci lta bu zhe na/ stobs bcu'i 'byung gnas tshul khrims rin po che'i ngo bor sdom pa gsum ga gcig ste/ so thar gyi lung la bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal nas/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya ste/ dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad// rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// 'dul ba bsdus te bstan pa yin// zhes dang*/ 'dul ba lung rnam 'byed las/ 'di na gang zhig shing rtsa gtso bo dang*// rnam par 'phel dang kun 'dzin gnyis kyi gzhi// de bzhin chos rnams ma lus thams cad kyi// gzhi dang rtsa ba 'dul ba yin par bshad// ces so// bshes springs las/ khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu sa bzhin du// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten yin par bshad// ces so// byang sems kyang rig thog 'dir so thar gyi dgag sgrub nyams su len te/

spyod 'jug las/ sems bsrung brtul zhugs ma gtogs pa// brtul zhugs mang po ci zhig bya// sa steng 'di dag ko g.yogs kyang*// de nyid ko bas ga la lang*// lham mthil tsam zhig g.yogs pas na// sa steng 'di dag g.yogs dang mtshungs// zhes so// gsang sngags kyang so thar gyi dgag sgrub nyams su len/ lung las/ ma yengs pa dang mi 'da' ba// gnyis pos lam dang dam tshig rdzogs// zhes dang*/ yang gsang ba spyi rgyud las/ gcig pur rgyu zhing ring du gnas// lus med dbang po'i phug na gnas// 'dul bar dka' ba'i sems gdul bya// zhes dang*/ kyai'i rdo rje'i rgyud las/ rnal 'byor ma yi chos 'dul ba// nyin par nyid kyang rab bshad bya// zhes sogs mtha' yas so// des na phyag rgya chen po dang tshul khrims rin po che gcig pas te/ de'ang gcig tshul ni/ mtshungs par gcig phan tshun 'brel par gcig byed pa'i las gcig gshis stong pa nyid du gcig pa dang bzhi'o// mtshungs par gcig pa phyag dang tshul gnyis gcig rgya dang khrims gnyis gcig phan tshun 'brel bar gcig pa phyag tshul gnyis rig thog tu gcig byed pa'i las gcig pa phyag tshul gnyis kas ngan song las thar/ sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob/ gshis stong pa nyid du gcig phyag tshul gnyis ka gnyis su med pa'i ye shes chos kyi sku'o// sdom pa gsum gyi gsal byed dge slong kun dga' shes rab la gdams pa re zhig rdzogs so// maṅgalaṃ//
